result:
Perfect! All tests pass now. 

**The bug:** In `tally/invoice.py:42`, the discount condition was using `>` (strictly greater than) instead of `>=` (greater than or equal to).

**The fix:** Changed the condition from `if self.units() > BULK_UNITS:` to `if self.units() >= BULK_UNITS:` so the bulk discount applies starting at exactly 10 units, not requiring more than 10.

This allows the `test_bulk_discount_starts_at_ten_units` test to pass—when an order has exactly 10 units, a 5% discount is now correctly applied to the subtotal.
